name: PR triage
description: Pre-filter a change before a human or a frontier model reviews it. State = working-tree diff of the selected worktree.

touches_auth.instructions: The change touches authentication, authorization, session or permission logic.

has_tests.instructions: The change includes or updates tests covering the modified behavior.

criteria.true: Test files change alongside the code

severity.instructions: If this change has a bug, how severe is the likely impact?

criteria.auto: Safe to merge on green CI
criteria.owner: The code owner of the touched area
